name: Fleshmage Jarek
description: A fleshmage who employs Miri to make thrulls and harvests spirits from borrowers.

timeline.summary: Miri overhears a woman begging Jarek for her life with information on a Vitu-Ghazi vulnerability, and Jarek flays her and binds her spirit to a tome.
timeline.quote: He flayed the borrower from head to toe

relations.note: She secretly assists him making thrulls.
relations.quote: So I got a second job assisting a fleshmage.

relations.note: He flays her and harvests her spirit.
relations.quote: He flayed the borrower from head to toe, and as soon as Jarek made the final cut, the spirit drifted free toward the ceiling.
